register.labelZh: TAP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: tap somebody for something 可以幫助你理解與金錢、借款或出資有關的非正式請求。；你可以用 tap in 表達輸入密碼和數字,也可以用 tap out 表達打出訊息和回覆。；tap into 可以用來談論運用經驗、構思、知識、資料和有用的人際網絡。；tap out 可以描述用手指、腳、鉛筆或其他物件敲出的拍子和節奏。
register.summaryEn: Tap somebody for something helps you understand informal requests involving money, loans or contributions. You can use tap in for codes and numbers, and tap out for messages and replies. Tap into helps you talk about using experience, ideas, knowledge, information and useful networks. Tap out lets you describe rhythms made with fingers, feet, pencils or other objects.
